title: OctoRuntimeProtocolSchema
description: Serializable data shapes for the Octo Runtime NDJSON protocol. Runtime behavior remains hand-written in src/index.ts, and this schema is the source of truth for generated TypeScript types. The x-octo-unicode-scalar-strings semantic keyword requires every JSON string value and object member name to contain Unicode scalar values only: unpaired UTF-16 surrogates are rejected, not repaired or normalized. Consumers must enforce this protocol-wide rule even when validating a definition directly.

responseRequired.description: Whether an external response is required. Omission means required; false does not imply resolution or completion.

NotificationMessage.title: NotificationMessage
NotificationMessage.description: Public, channel-neutral project notification. No runtime context, reasoning, credentials, or tool payloads belong in this envelope.

ContextItem.title: ContextItem
ContextItem.description: Opaque ordered item. The envelope validates structure; consuming Adapters validate shared settings and their privately agreed payloads. Private items require no public registration.
ContextItem.tsType: { namespace: string; name: string; guidance?: string; data_format?: 'text'; payload: Record<string, unknown> }

guidance.description: Optional producer metadata. Runtime does not render AgentEnv items into model input.

data_format.description: Optional producer metadata; it does not request Runtime rendering.

ContextEnvelope.title: ContextEnvelope
ContextEnvelope.description: In addition to draft-07 validation, every consumer must enforce the x-octo semantic keywords: unique ordered namespace/name tuples, compact UTF-8 JSON byte budget, JSON nesting depth with the envelope at depth zero, and Unicode scalar strings in every nested value and object key. Canonical hashing uses ECMAScript JSON number serialization, including -0 becoming 0 and normalized exponent notation; object keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units before ECMAScript integer-index enumeration. U+2028/U+2029 and non-ASCII scalar values are not escaped or Unicode-normalized.

ContextConfiguration.title: ContextConfiguration
ContextConfiguration.description: Agent defaults and mandatory execution constraints stored under one external configuration version. Application prompts belong to caller-provided ordinary inputs, not execution settings.

RunContextProjection.title: RunContextProjection
RunContextProjection.description: Public Context facts. Preparation is distinct from Adapter application or invocation. This projection excludes resource files, trusted instruction text, credentials and Runtime paths.

object_materials.description: Frozen inline object facts proven by a matching preparation receipt. Source fields are provenance claims, not access grants. No contents, local handles, paths or credentials are exposed; application is separately evidenced by application_status.

ContextPreparationReceipt.title: ContextPreparationReceipt
ContextPreparationReceipt.description: Preparation facts for the current Run lease and caller-owned workspace path; they do not prove Provider use of model context or transfer directory ownership to Runtime.

ContextWorkspacePayload.description: Caller-owned, already prepared directory. Runtime validates the concrete local execution path and never allocates or recreates an application workspace.

ContextLimitsPayload.description: Snake-case frozen watchdog limits, with the same bounds as RuntimeLimits. Legacy enforcement=observe cannot be combined with v2 settings.

ResolvedRuntimeSelection.title: ResolvedRuntimeSelection
ResolvedRuntimeSelection.description: Worker-frozen Context runtime candidates. Explicit selection cannot fail over.

MessageChannel.title: MessageChannel
MessageChannel.description: Provider-neutral assistant output channel. analysis is reasoning-class content gated by exposure; commentary is public in-run progress; final is answer content delivered only after the Run reaches a completed terminal state.

MessageExposure.title: MessageExposure
MessageExposure.description: Adapter-authenticated classification of analysis content. public_reasoning, public_summary, and public_plan may enter a public Presentation; missing values are unknown.

MessageProvenance.title: MessageProvenance
MessageProvenance.description: Provider-native provenance written by the adapter. Audience projectors use it to audit public exposure and clients cannot override it.

provider.description: Adapter or provider type that produced the message.

nativeEvent.description: Provider-native event type that was normalized.

FailureAction.title: FailureAction
FailureAction.description: A catalog-controlled recovery action. Clients render labelKey and must not execute arbitrary commands from this object.

FailureSource.title: FailureSource
FailureSource.description: Low-cardinality component identity. It intentionally excludes hostnames, paths, accounts, and tenant data.

FailureCause.title: FailureCause
FailureCause.description: Sanitized machine-readable root cause. Raw stderr, response bodies, paths, and credentials are forbidden.

FailureEnvelope.title: FailureEnvelope
FailureEnvelope.description: Versioned, safe failure fact shared by Runtime, Worker, and channel projectors. Public codes are immutable catalog identifiers; dynamic diagnostics stay outside this object.

ProviderSession.title: ProviderSession
ProviderSession.description: Provider-owned session resume data. Core treats sessionId and adapter extension fields as opaque.

resumable.description: Whether the provider declares that later invocations can resume this session.

requireResume.description: Require the original provider session; adapters must reject rather than start a fresh fallback. Currently implemented by Codex.

resumeOutcome.description: Continuity outcome for this session update. Compaction applies to the next turn; fresh fallback applies to the current turn.

resumeFallback.description: Low-cardinality reason for a fresh resume fallback.

contextInputVariant.description: Frozen context input variant actually selected for the current provider turn.

QuestionRequest.description: Non-blocking question batch. IDs are positions scoped to this interaction, not provider-native question IDs.

CanonicalEventPayload.title: CanonicalEventPayload
CanonicalEventPayload.description: Shared canonical event payload. The open dictionary carries structured tool, surface, and usage fields while common lifecycle fields remain explicit.

delivery.description: Async questions do not block provider work. Omitted for existing synchronous interactions.

questions.description: Message snapshot only; an active interaction.requested authorizes submission.

stepId.description: Stable model-step identifier used to associate messages and tool calls with one provider turn.

status.description: Tool call or run status identifier.

AsyncQuestionReplySnapshot.description: Host-owned supplement state, never stored by Kernel. Submitting or unknown records cannot be replayed.

InteractionRequestedPayload.title: InteractionRequestedPayload
InteractionRequestedPayload.description: Provider-neutral interaction. Omitted delivery retains synchronous blocking semantics; async questions allow continued work. Only Adapter-owned automatic approvals may omit external responses; this does not imply completion.

responseRequired.description: Whether an external response is required. Omission means required; only an Adapter-owned automatic approval may set false.

request.description: Display-safe provider request projected for the responding product.

ApprovalRequest.description: Supported profile: original native request approval with requestedPermissions=[] only. Non-empty permission instances fail with APPROVAL_PERMISSION_UNSUPPORTED; consumers must not fabricate them. Details are allowlisted inert metadata. The compact UTF-8 JSON budget is enforced by x-octo-max-json-bytes.

ApprovalDisplayDetails.description: Display-only fields permitted by assertApprovalRequest. Values remain inert provider metadata and do not redefine commands, permissions or grant scope.

ModelStepStartedPayload.title: ModelStepStartedPayload
ModelStepStartedPayload.description: Starts one provider model round. A round may contain public reasoning, tool calls, and text output.

stepId.description: Stable identifier reused by model_step.finished and child events.

startedAtMs.description: Provider-observed round content-start timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

ModelStepFinishedPayload.title: ModelStepFinishedPayload
ModelStepFinishedPayload.description: Finishes one provider model round and records why control returned to the harness.

finishReason.description: Provider-normalized reason such as tool-calls or stop.

endedAtMs.description: Provider-observed round finish timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

ToolCallCreatePayload.title: ToolCallCreatePayload
ToolCallCreatePayload.description: Formal tool_call.create payload. args preserves the original structured input, including args.command for shell tools.

id.description: Stable tool call identifier reused by later delta and update events.

args.description: Original structured input known when the tool call starts. Streaming providers may begin empty and append argsDelta.

ToolCallDeltaPayload.title: ToolCallDeltaPayload
ToolCallDeltaPayload.description: Formal tool_call.delta payload. argsDelta is an ordered raw JSON fragment and must be concatenated before parsing.

id.description: Stable identifier from the corresponding tool_call.create event.

argsDelta.description: Raw JSON argument fragment; do not parse fragments independently.

outputSnapshot.description: Full replacement of a provider rolling output snapshot; never an activity or a terminal status.

ToolCallUpdatePayload.title: ToolCallUpdatePayload
ToolCallUpdatePayload.description: Formal tool_call.update payload that closes the tool lifecycle and carries its final result.

id.description: Stable identifier from the corresponding tool_call.create event.

output.description: Final tool output as text or structured JSON.

exitCode.description: Process exit code for command tools.

RunIdentity.title: RunIdentity
RunIdentity.description: Stable run identity used by envelopes without requiring the complete domain object.

McpStdioServer.title: McpStdioServer
McpStdioServer.description: A per-invocation MCP server launched as a child process by the provider.

McpStreamableHttpServer.title: McpStreamableHttpServer
McpStreamableHttpServer.description: A per-invocation Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Header values are sensitive and must never enter logs or canonical events.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) endpoint or environment template; the resolved endpoint is validated again before connecting.

McpServers.title: McpServers
McpServers.description: Dynamic server-name map. No business-specific names are enumerated. Each value must match one closed transport variant.

ModelInputPart.title: ModelInputPart
ModelInputPart.description: Ordered provider-native user input. Image bytes are materialized only for the invocation, never used as a text fallback.

InvokeRequestWire.title: InvokeRequestWire
InvokeRequestWire.description: Serializable execution request sent from Core to Adapter Host. AbortSignal is added in src/index.ts because it cannot cross a process boundary.

executionEnvOverrides.description: Trusted ingress execution environment, independent of business Context; never render or persist in business snapshots.

invocationId.description: Active Adapter Host invocation identifier and cancellation target.

agentSessionId.description: Long-lived Agent Worker session identifier for this execution context.

sessionName.description: Caller-owned nonblank display name of 1-256 Unicode code points, without C0/DEL/C1 controls; independent of business identity and opaque provider recovery handles.

sessionGeneration.description: Worker-owned AgentSession generation that fences stale continuity updates.

providerEpoch.description: Worker-owned provider binding epoch for this Run.

continuityMode.description: Caller continuity intent. Fresh invocations must not carry providerSession.

prompt.description: Display-safe current request or task description. It excludes hidden channel context and provider control parameters.

freshFallbackImagesUnavailable.description: Recovery includes historical images whose bytes are unavailable. Adapters must fail before sending a fresh prompt.

freshFallbackModelInput.description: Frozen alternate user turn for the first turn of a fresh provider session after resume fails.

ContextInlineEntry.description: Untrusted inline selection text with optional resource reference, source metadata and summary. Source metadata is not an authorization claim.

ContextReferenceEntry.description: Declarative MCP resource operation. Only deployed scoped operations may execute; schema validation does not authorize access.

params.description: Frozen non-secret JSON parameters supplied by the authenticated resolver plan, not model-generated commands.

ToolAuthorization.title: ToolAuthorization
ToolAuthorization.description: Business authorization intent; never a tool installation definition.

IssuedToolAuthorization.title: IssuedToolAuthorization
IssuedToolAuthorization.description: Run lease-bound credentials delivered over the authenticated Runtime channel. Never enter provider configuration, prompts or logs.

ContextEnvsPayload.title: ContextEnvsPayload
ContextEnvsPayload.description: Run 级环境变量列表；以 key 标识变量，按 key 合并，不进入模型输入。

ContextMcpPayload.title: ContextMcpPayload
ContextMcpPayload.description: Run-scoped MCP connection templates. Server names are dynamic keys; values are validated by transport. Variables resolve only in the execution environment, never in the model context.

sessionName.description: Optional caller-owned nonblank display name of 1-256 Unicode code points, without C0/DEL/C1 controls; Core supplies a random UUID default without business naming policy.

AgentEnv.title: AgentEnv
AgentEnv.description: Execution envelope forwarded unchanged to the Adapter. Only shared bean types belong to the public protocol; Harness-specific payloads are private agreements between the caller and its Adapter.
